title: MSCR: Jointly Balancing Utilization Across Modalities and Discovering Synergistic Information
abstract: arXiv:2610.24395v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In multimodal learning, modality imbalance often lets one modality dominate optimization and keeps the model from fully exploiting cross-modal interactions. Balance-oriented methods such as the Multimodal Competition Regularizer (MCR) perform well by alleviating this imbalance during training. These dynamic balancing methods, however, mainly adjust modality contributions and do not consider how imbalance affects the formation of synergistic information during fusion. Synergy is a major source of multimodal advantage, because it is predictive gain that cannot be recovered from unimodal evidence alone. We propose the Multimodal Synergistic Competition Regularizer (MSCR), a fusion method that jointly promotes balanced modality utilization and the discovery of synergistic information. translated_title: MSCR：联合平衡跨模态利用率与发现协同信息
translated_abstract: 在多模态学习中，模态不平衡常常使某一模态主导优化过程，导致模型无法充分利用跨模态交互。以平衡为导向的方法，如多模态竞争正则化器，通过在训练过程中缓解这种不平衡而表现出色。然而，这些动态平衡方法主要调整模态贡献，并未考虑不平衡如何影响融合过程中协同信息的形成。协同性是多模态优势的重要来源，因为它是仅凭单模态证据无法恢复的预测增益。我们提出了多模态协同竞争正则化器（MSCR），这是一种联合促进平衡模态利用率与协同信息发现的融合方法。MSCR包含两个互补的目标：反主导目标抑制过度的单模态影响，为协同信息留出空间，并且……
tldr: 提出MSCR融合方法，通过反主导目标抑制单模态过度影响并促进协同信息的发现，从而联合实现模态利用的平衡与多模态优势的充分挖掘。
